The target video is a living gouache painting in <Subject 1>: shapes stay flat and matte with soft paper grain, and the rings and ribbons move like slow, gentle strokes of paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The figure keeps turning slowly on the water, arms raised, and each step sends a new ring of color across the lake. The rings lift gently off the water and stretch into long soft ribbons of coral, teal, lilac and gold that rise and curl upward like voices. The camera tilts up slowly at a steady speed in one continuous move, the lake and the dancer sliding down toward the bottom of the frame while the open sky fills with the drifting ribbons, the pink dusk deepening toward evening blue. The camera is still tilting up as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
